about_the_game:
KARMZAH 
Step into the shoes of Morowa Adjei, a daring archaeologist whose life changes forever when she Discovers an ancient artifact. This relic transforms her into Karmzah, a formidable warrior whose strength flows through her assistive powerful crutches weapons forged by the legendary MUZU.

In this fast-paced side-scrolling action-adventure, face ancient terrors and modern foes across handcrafted landscapes. Wield Karmzah’s adaptive combat style, chaining combo and acrobatic maneuvers to outwit enemies in electrifying battles. Your reflexes will be pushed to the limit as you dodge, counter, and unleash awesome attacks.

Beyond combat, the world is a riddled with puzzles and traps, daring you to use intellect and agility to survive. You won’t face the journey alone—your sharp-witted sidekick, Muzu, is always ready with insight, sass, and surprises.

Inspired by the groundbreaking comic Karmzah, created by Farida Bedwei, this game is more than an adventure. It’s a bold celebration of resilience, representation, and enablement. Karmzah is a journey unlike any other with a distinct art style, a gripping story, and deep customization.

Will you rise to the challenge and wield your strength with purpose?

short_description: Karmzah is a side-scrolling action-adventure game, following Morowa Adjei, an archaeologist with Cerebral Palsy. A powerful artifact transforms her into Karmzah, granting abilities to battle threats, solve puzzles and explore rich environments. it champions disability representation in gaming.
